plan: REP-2 (plan 2026-10-28 §4.8 and §5.4): Report's own analytics database, ingest, shadow comparison and the Billing revenue read; no cutover
runtime: node 22, express 4, PostgreSQL (PGlite in development), no sessions
summary: OpenVibe.Report keeps its own PostgreSQL analytics store (migrations/), ingests Network's live.stream.ended and frame beacon plus its open-stats answer idempotently (report_inbox), computes the same site-wide, per-site and per-channel numbers by day, quotes Billing's revenue through Billing's read API, and runs a shadow job that records every difference from Network in report_shadow_diffs with GET /internal/shadow on loopback. REPORT_SOURCE=network (default) keeps the pages on today's Network numbers; REPORT_SOURCE=report answers them from Report's tables. The Rundown and after-show pages still read OpenVibe.Live.
works: Database: server/db.js (openvibe-sdk/db, migrations at boot; PostgreSQL through PgBouncer, PGlite in development) and test/helpers/db.js (createTestDb)
Tables: report_inbox, report_events, report_streams, report_frame_days, report_metric_days, report_metric_windows, report_metric_json, report_dimensions, report_shadow_runs, report_shadow_diffs

Ingest: live.stream.ended → report_streams and channel/day counts; network.frame.hit/day → report_frame_days; GET /api/v1/stats → day and window metrics, JSON lists and site dimensions; every write claimed in report_inbox in the same transaction

Read: reportStats() reproduces GET /api/v1/stats (totals, sites, pageviews_daily, accounts, coins, live, busiest pages); channelStats() reproduces creator analytics from report_streams and adds Billing revenue; metrics() returns report.metric@1 rows

Billing: GET /api/v1/stats with billing.stats.read; GET /api/v1/transactions?subject= with billing.balance.read for settled creator_payable revenue/refunds; service token via Network client-credentials or REPORT_BILLING_TOKEN; never derives a price
Shadow: server/analytics/shadow.js compares the same window from Network and Report, records report_shadow_runs + report_shadow_diffs; GET/POST /internal/shadow (loopback)
Jobs: ingest 7/30/90-day windows every 5 minutes and shadow every 15 minutes (server/jobs/analytics.js), on by default; REPORT_JOBS=0 turns them off
Events: POST /internal/events with Events v2 HMAC, loopback only
Source switch: REPORT_SOURCE=network|report (default network) for /, /stats and GET /api/v1/stats
Tests: ingest idempotency, every metric from a fixture, shadow difference and clean run, source flag, Billing stub, signed Events delivery, and the existing pages/API/health/crawl tests
notYet: Cutover: REPORT_SOURCE stays network; Network and Live keep answering until the shadow is clean for a full window
Report's first-party grants on Network (billing.stats.read, billing.balance.read, and the Network analytics grant when creator analytics is pulled directly) are not created by this change
No report service manifest or capabilities are registered in openvibe-contracts yet; report.metric@1 is proposed in docs/report.metric.v1.json
The ingest job reads Network's open-stats answer; it does not call Network's creator analytics endpoint (channels come from live.stream.ended)
The Rundown and after-show pages remain Live reads until Report takes those products
features: analytics ingest with an event-id inbox
site and channel metrics by day
deployment: planned: openvibe-ovh, unit openvibe-report.service on 127.0.0.1:5080 (git checkout /opt/openvibe.report, env /etc/openvibe/report.env), public at https://openvibe.report; DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_DIRECT_URL from OpenVibe.Host roles/data add-service.sh report
